page_title: CHE 4-4 MCI | Chelsea v Manchester City 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Referee Anthony Taylor halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Mauricio Pochettino, then shows him a yellow.
90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) has tested the patience of referee Anthony Taylor and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+6' Today's match ends for Nicolas Jackson who will be replaced by Chimuanya Ugochukwu (Chelsea).
90+5' 4 - 4 Goal! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) puts the ball into the top left corner past the outstretched arm of Ederson.
90+4' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is going to take the penalty!
90+4' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90+4' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+2' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Chelsea have been awarded a penalty kick!
90+2' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul after Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) hacks down one of his opponents.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Armando Broja (Chelsea) is coming onto the pitch as Moises Caicedo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' 3 - 4 It's in the back of the net! Rodri (Manchester City) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Robert Sanchez. He makes it 3:4.
83' The attendance for today's match is 39532.
82' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Anthony Taylor saw the whole situation.
79' That will be all from Julian Alvarez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City).
79' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
78' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
75' Raheem Sterling plays a through ball to Malo Gusto (Chelsea) inside the box, he has time and arrows at shot that just goes over the bar. That really was a good chance!
72' Rodri (Manchester City) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
67' 3 - 3 Goal! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:3.
66' Ederson (Manchester City) is able to continue to play.
65' Ederson (Manchester City) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' Mauricio Pochettino decides to make a substitution. Reece James will be replaced by Malo Gusto (Chelsea).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Enzo Fernandez leaves the pitch and Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) comes on.
64' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kyle Walker (Manchester City).
63' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) sends a chip pass into the box, but Robert Sanchez is quickest to intercept the ball.
60' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
60' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeremy Doku trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jack Grealish (Manchester City).

58' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot low into the middle of the goal, but Robert Sanchez makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
58' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) commits a foul after dangerous play.
57' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ederson, who smothers the ball.
56' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
55' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) was too forceful with his tackle and Anthony Taylor interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
54' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
53' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) beats a few defenders in the penalty area and drives a low shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to make a wonderful save.
49' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Anthony Taylor signals that there was no handball and the goal stands! The Manchester City players celebrate.
48' The Manchester City players halt their celebrations as referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.

47' 2 - 3 Julian Alvarez produces a sweet pass and picks out Erling Haaland (Manchester City) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 2:3!
46' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) jumps into a tackle and Anthony Taylor signals a foul.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+7' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ederson intercepts the ball.
45+7' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
45+7' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
45+5' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
45+2' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) brings his opponent down. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.

45+1' 2 - 2 Goal! Bernardo Silva clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Manuel Akanji (Manchester City), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the left side of the goal. Robert Sanchez had no chance of stopping that. 2:2.
45+1' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.

43' Phil Foden (Manchester City) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Robert Sanchez sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
42' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) tackles a bit over-zealously and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
42' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) commits a rough foul. Anthony Taylor stops the game and makes a call.
42' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Robert Sanchez pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
40' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Kyle Walker (Manchester City) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' 2 - 1 Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
34' Phil Foden (Manchester City) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
32' Phil Foden dinks a lofted pass into the path of Erling Haaland (Manchester City) inside the box, but his drive sails a whisker past the left post.

29' 1 - 1 Goal! Conor Gallagher launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of Thiago Silva (Chelsea), whose accurate effort from near the penalty spot went straight into the left side of the goal. It's 1:1.
29' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) will take a corner kick.

28' Reece James (Chelsea) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Ederson to dive and make a save. The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.
27' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Rodri (Manchester City).
26' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
25' 0 - 1 GOAL! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) sends the penalty kick low into the left of the net.
23' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
23' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
22' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
22' It’s a PENALTY to Manchester City after the VAR review!
22' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Manchester City as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
21' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is penalised for holding. Anthony Taylor signals a set piece. Manchester City are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!

19' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the middle of the target, but Ederson pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.

17' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) rises high to meet a perfect corner kick and sends in a long-range header from the edge of the box. The effort goes straight at the goalkeeper's gloves, causing him little trouble.
16' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) will deliver the corner kick.
16' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
15' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
12' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
8' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
5' The corner from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is intercepted by Ederson.

5' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) attempts to find Marc Cucurella with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee signals a corner kick to Chelsea.
4' Anthony Taylor couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) and blew his whistle.
1' Reece James (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Chelsea will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Anthony Taylor.
